name: SpectatedPlayerComponentServerFacet_SetIsPublic
summary: The client tells the spectated-player server facet whether it is public. A 45-byte record with a 17-byte body: the shared two-u64 head then ONE strict boolean byte. It shares the bool reader FUN_1425a3070 with 0x101d, 0x10b0 and the two mount toggles, so the width and the strictness are codec facts and not sample guesses.
purpose: Set whether this player is publicly spectatable. What the server does with the value is not measured.

created_when: the client's spectated-player component pushes its public/private state
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never learns the player's spectating visibility

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 9a 40, i.e. type index 4122 = 0x101a. A client record carries the body at record offset 28: the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id precede the typed header, so a 17-byte body makes a 45-byte record.

fields.name: local_facet_id
fields.note: Measured 95 a5 a8 0a a5 42 88 d1 = 0x95a5a80aa54288d1. First u64 of the shared message head: the sending facet's own local id. One of the per-component facet ids; it appears on this wire only.

fields.name: local_actor_id_word0
fields.note: Measured bf 85 31 4b bc 4a 95 1a = 0xbf85314bbc4a951a, the first 8 bytes of the client's own actor id - the same value every other capture carries.
fields.provenance: already earned in msg.time-sync-to-client.json; re-measured here

fields.name: enabled_flag
fields.note: Measured 0x00, leaving nothing over: 16 + 1 = 17 exactly. The reader writes the object's +0x20 byte as a single strict non-zero test and its decode side FUN_1425a30b0 rejects any byte at or above 2, so the width and the strictness are both from the codec. What the flag SWITCHES is not measured: only the value 0 was captured, so the field is named for the on/off setting the message name announces, not for an observed behaviour.
